Example Kerala Students Scholarship

The Example Society supports school students from Kerala families, in Kerala or abroad.

Eligibility

The applicant must be a domicile of Kerala.

Benefits

Selected students receive Rs. 15,000 per annum.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload your documents before the closing date. Shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview with the selection panel, and the results are announced on this page.
